source: written, not recorded (2026-10-22, wave 1 K7): commands, self-knowledge and notes grounding for a body that hears, moves its head and has a camera not connected yet; expected to fail on the notes build (no body, notes on every line) and to be run in wave 3 (make eval)
body: A Reachy Mini: a head that turns and tilts, two antennas, a speaker, four microphones, and a camera that is not connected yet.

body_plan.name: body_plan
body_plan.description: Move your head when asked: look or turn somewhere, search for the person, track them, stop. Steps run in order; a step may last until a face is found or it times out.

chained: Search for me, then track me.
Turn around and look for me.
Look up, then look down, then look at me.
negatives: I looked left and right before crossing the street.
My friend turned around and walked off.
I can't stop thinking about that film.
The police tracked the stolen car for an hour.
Have you ever looked for something you were holding?

has_camera: Have you got a camera in there?
cannot_see: What am I holding up right now?
